about: 지출결의서(원본 회계 I › 현금거래 › 지출결의서 E010408, 2026-10-12 실측) — 빈 채로 [저장(F8)] → 계정칸 '계정코드를 입력 바랍니다.', 계좌칸에 '현금' Enter → 000 현금 · 계정 811 복리후생비가 찬다, 금액 12,000 · 적요 저장 → 빈 화면. 분개 차) 복리후생비 12,000 / 대) 현금 12,000(적요 같음). 시험 전표는 API 로 지운다. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/expense-report.json

shots.name: 빈 저장 거절 → 현금 줄 저장 → 분개
steps: js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const c = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="계좌검색"]'); set(c, '현금'); c.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return true })()
expect:(() => { const tr = document.querySelector('table.ec-grid-input tbody tr'); return tr.innerText.includes('현금') && tr.innerText.includes('복리후생비') })()

js:(() => { const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 금액"]'), '12000'); set(document.querySelector('input[aria-label="1줄 적요명"]'), 'QA회계1-flow 식대'); return true })()

expect:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/vouchers?type=EXPENSE_REPORT', { headers: H })).json(); const v = d.rows.find((r) => r.lines.some((l) => l.description === 'QA회계1-flow 식대')); if (!v) return false; const j = await (await fetch('/api/journals/' + v.journalEntryId, { headers: H })).json(); const ok = j.lines.some((l) => l.accountCode === '8109' && Number(l.debit) === 12000 && l.description === 'QA회계1-flow 식대') && j.lines.some((l) => l.accountCode === '1019' && Number(l.credit) === 12000 && l.description === 'QA회계1-flow 식대'); await fetch('/api/vouchers/' + v.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return ok })()
